description: Compare two versions of one application from their running deployments, to back a rollback or promote decision: deployments in error, crash restarts and exit codes, and CPU and memory (average, p95, peak) against each version's requested cpu_units and memory_mb, with the differences spelled out. Reads up to 20 running deployments per version, newest first, so both versions need deployments running now (stopped ones keep no logs or status). Read-only.

version_a.description: The baseline version, e.g. the one in production.

version_b.description: The version to compare against it, e.g. the new build.

name: edgegap_compare_versions
title: Compare two versions of an application
